minimumShippedUx.visibleObjective: Every shipped feature has a mission objective, HUD line, Terminal row, or scan/marker state that tells the player what to do next.
minimumShippedUx.readableFeedback: Completion, warning, reward, and blocked states use player-facing labels instead of internal event names.
minimumShippedUx.playerFacingExplanation: Each system has a short explanation in Terminal, Wiki, Codex/Index, Lens, HoloMap, or item/block tooltip where the player naturally meets it.
minimumShippedUx.supportSurfaces: Use HUD for immediate state, Terminal for route planning, Index/Codex/Wiki for explanations, Lens for local scanning, and HoloMap for spatial route context.
minimumShippedUx.assetCompleteness: Missions and systems ship with lang, icon/model/texture surfaces, valid recipes and loot where craftable/placeable, and Terminal mission art.
minimumShippedUx.noDebugPlaceholders: No player-facing text may present itself as raw telemetry, stub copy, unfinished authoring notes, or null output.

surfaceLegend.direct: Required for the feature to feel shippable.
surfaceLegend.supporting: Required when the installed addon/service is present or when the feature is route-facing.
surfaceLegend.notApplicable: Not required for this feature because another surface is the natural player entry point.

features.playerPromise: The player understands the first ten minutes before leaving the pod.
features.visibleObjective: Welcome screen, starter note, HUD/chat line, and first MissionCore objectives point to shelter, tool, water, and Terminal handoff.
features.readableFeedback: Starting kit, emergency buffer, and Terminal/Wiki availability are explained with survival language.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Welcome screen, starter item note, first-month Terminal page, first-steps Wiki article, Index starter entries, Lens profile, and HoloMap layer.

features.playerPromise: Water is readable as a loop: dirty, filter, boil, clean, reserve.
features.visibleObjective: Clean-water, rain collector, and purifier missions expose exact carry/place requirements.
features.readableFeedback: Water item names, mission completion text, and route prep copy explain why clean reserves matter.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Water bottles, crude filter, rain collector, water purifier, Terminal route copy, Index starter entry, and Wiki first steps.

features.playerPromise: Shelter is treated as a route anchor, not a decorative suggestion.
features.visibleObjective: Secure-shelter and base-stability objectives name shelter, light, return path, and storage expectations.
features.readableFeedback: Welcome cards, starter note, and mission copy describe the pod or nearby ruins as a safe return marker.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Welcome screen, starter note, first-steps Wiki article, HoloMap safe-route markers, and Terminal prep panels.

features.playerPromise: The player can identify the first useful tool and why it matters.
features.visibleObjective: Craft-scrap-knife and field-kit missions name the tool, materials, and survival purpose.
features.readableFeedback: Tooltips and mission completion text explain the role of scrap tools without hidden recipe knowledge.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Scrap knife tooltip, primitive-tool missions, starter note, and first-steps Wiki copy.

features.playerPromise: Rain collector, hand recycler, field kit, and schematics read as the first production bridge.
features.visibleObjective: Build and assemble missions expose place/obtain objectives with item icons.
features.readableFeedback: Completion text and reward labels state what the machine or kit unlocks.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Recipes, loot, item/block names, tooltips, mission art, Terminal panels, and Index entries.

features.playerPromise: Machines, power, cables, batteries, and logistics blocks show purpose, state, recipe path, and payoff.
features.visibleObjective: Machine/power missions and native resource audit cover machine casing through Nexus capacitor.
features.readableFeedback: HUD readouts, UI panels, mission completion text, and Terminal help name capacity, priority, and next upgrade.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Block/item models and textures, recipes, loot tables, lang, Terminal help, Codex/Index entries, and machine UI panels.

features.playerPromise: Scanning produces readable intel, faction contact, map context, and rewards without looking like raw telemetry.
features.visibleObjective: Scanner, faction signal, cache sweep, and route missions link Lens rows to HoloMap markers and Index entries.
features.readableFeedback: Lens risk labels, HoloMap prep text, faction Terminal copy, cache loot labels, and reward presentation explain consequences.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Scanner UI, Lens scan profiles, HoloMap POIs, faction Terminal pages, drone HUD, cache loot, and faction reward text.

features.playerPromise: Hazards, mutation, med bay, lab/vaults, data logs, radiation, and atmosphere expose risk and recovery.
features.visibleObjective: Midgame missions name scans, treatment, lab entry, vault clearance, and data-log recovery.
features.readableFeedback: Hazard readouts, mutation display, med bay UI, and data-log text make status changes legible.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Terminal lab/vault pages, Codex/Index documentation, Lens profiles, HoloMap hazard markers, radiation docs, and atmosphere docs.

features.playerPromise: Bosses, Nexus state, Prime relays, branch choices, and endings have readable stakes and presentation.
features.visibleObjective: Boss missions, Nexus missions, Prime relay scans, and ending branch missions expose branch-specific next steps.
features.readableFeedback: Boss intel, Nexus UI, relay pages, ending branch presentation, and late-game HoloMap state communicate consequences.
features.playerFacingExplanation: Terminal relay pages, Codex/Index entries, HoloMap state, Lens profiles, boss mission art, and ending text.
